heroes.name: Ana
heroes.biography: An Egyptian veteran sniper who supports allies from range.
weaknesses: Aim-dependent healing
a missed defensive dart leaves fewer answers

attributes.Mobility: No movement ability in the captured kit
attributes.Survivability: Sleep and grenade protect a threatened position
attributes.Skill floor: Practice the kit’s timing and movement before combining full engagements.
attributes.Skill ceiling: Coordinate Nano Boost before the fight. Track cleansing and defensive abilities before committing your grenade.

abilities.name: Biotic Rifle
abilities.description: Use the scope for distant shots; the rifle damages opponents and restores teammates' health.

abilities.name: Sleep Dart
abilities.description: A landed dart temporarily incapacitates an opponent.

abilities.name: Biotic Grenade
abilities.description: The grenade helps allies recover while denying healing to enemies caught by it.

abilities.name: Nano Boost
abilities.description: Empower a teammate's damage output and resistance to incoming damage.

guides.title: Build a safe position
guides.body: Keep an ally and a retreat corner in view. Avoid angles where only the enemy can reach you.
guides.drill: Play one match and record three moments where cover would have kept you safe.

guides.title: Manage your resources
guides.body: Save Sleep Dart when a diver is approaching. Use Biotic Grenade when your team can act on the healing denial.
guides.drill: Review three deaths and identify the defensive ability you spent too early.

guides.title: Coordinate the engagement
guides.body: Coordinate Nano Boost before the fight. Track cleansing and defensive abilities before committing your grenade.
guides.drill: Before each fight, name your target and your exit route. Review whether both were realistic.

perks.name: Local Anesthetic
perks.description: Sleep dart explodes on impact, slowing enemies and dealing 45 damage over 3 seconds.

perks.name: Speed Serum
perks.description: Nano Boost grants a 30% movement speed boost to both Ana and her target.

perks.name: Biotic Bounce
perks.description: After exploding, Biotic Grenade bounces and explodes again for 60 damage and healing.

perks.name: Headhunter
perks.description: Biotic Rifle can crit enemies.

heroes.name: Anran
heroes.biography: A graduate of Wuxing University's Fire College who specializes in fire attacks.
weaknesses: Healing from Dancing Blaze needs enemies in reach
rushing without an exit spends mobility

attributes.Survivability: Dancing Blaze avoids damage and heals through hits
attributes.Skill floor: Practice aim, resource timing and safe repositioning together.
attributes.Skill ceiling: Plan where Inferno Rush or Vermillion Ascent will leave you. If using Vermillion Revival, judge the surviving enemy pressure rather than assuming a return will make the original engagement safe.

abilities.name: Zhuque Fans
abilities.description: Launch fire projectiles from the fans.

abilities.name: Fan the Flames
abilities.description: A heated blast increases the effect of burning damage.

abilities.name: Dancing Blaze
abilities.description: Avoid incoming damage during the attack and recover health from enemies struck.

abilities.name: Inferno Rush
abilities.description: Move forward with a damaging collision.

abilities.name: Vermillion Ascent
abilities.description: A forward charge ends in an explosion that sets opponents alight.

abilities.name: Vermillion Revival
abilities.description: Return from death through an explosive fire effect.

abilities.name: Ignition
abilities.description: Fire attacks apply a burning effect.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Approach from cover with a route back to your team. Use your fire projectiles to establish pressure before committing movement toward an enemy.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Fan the Flames interacts with burning targets. Check that the target is affected before spending the follow-up, and use Dancing Blaze when nearby enemies make its defensive and healing effects useful.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Plan where Inferno Rush or Vermillion Ascent will leave you. If using Vermillion Revival, judge the surviving enemy pressure rather than assuming a return will make the original engagement safe.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

perks.name: Smoulder
perks.description: Ignited enemies burn 1.5 seconds longer.

perks.name: Heat Shield
perks.description: Gain 50 overhealth when you use your Ultimate and for each enemy ignited by it.

perks.name: Short Fuse
perks.description: Impacting an enemy with Inferno Rush reduces its cooldown by 1.5 seconds.

perks.name: Hungering Blaze
perks.description: Increase the healing of Dancing Blaze's subsequent strikes by 25.

heroes.name: Ashe
heroes.biography: A Deadlock gang leader who fights with a rifle and explosives.
weaknesses: Aiming slows firing
the movement tool also spends your close-range displacement

attributes.Skill floor: Practice the kit’s timing and movement before combining full engagements.
attributes.Skill ceiling: Place B.O.B. where his line of fire complements your team's angle. Announce the deployment and watch for abilities that can shut him down.

abilities.name: The Viper
abilities.description: Aiming increases rifle accuracy and damage while reducing firing speed.

abilities.name: Coach Gun
abilities.description: The blast separates nearby enemies and propels you backward.

abilities.name: Dynamite
abilities.description: Shoot the thrown explosive for early detonation or let its timer expire.

abilities.name: B.O.B.
abilities.description: Send B.O.B. charging into opponents before he begins firing.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Aim from cover with The Viper and leave Coach Gun available if a diver reaches you. A useful angle needs an exit as well as a target.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Shoot Dynamite when its explosion can pressure several enemies or force them out of cover. Do not stay scoped when your position is being contested.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Place B.O.B. where his line of fire complements your team's angle. Announce the deployment and watch for abilities that can shut him down.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

perks.name: Remote Detonator
perks.description: After using Dynamite, pressing E again causes it to detonate after a 0.5 second delay.

perks.name: Double-Barreled
perks.description: Knocking an enemy back with Coach Gun allows you use it one extra time within 2 seconds.

perks.name: Viper's Sting
perks.description: Hitting 2 consecutive scoped shots on a target deals 25 extra damage.

perks.name: Airburst
perks.description: Dynamite has a 40% increased detonation radius while airborne and refunds 6 ammo when thrown.

heroes.name: Baptiste
heroes.biography: A former Talon medic who now uses his combat training to help people harmed by war.
weaknesses: Field placement is vulnerable to destruction
healing must land near allies

attributes.Survivability: Regenerative Burst and a destroyable Immortality Field
attributes.Skill floor: Practice aim, resource timing and safe repositioning together.
attributes.Skill ceiling: Amplification Matrix needs a usable firing lane. Communicate its position before the fight and do not force teammates to abandon cover just to shoot through it.

abilities.name: Biotic Launcher
abilities.description: Alternate burst fire with healing projectiles that affect teammates near their landing point.

abilities.name: Regenerative Burst
abilities.description: Restore nearby teammates immediately and over time; the immediate heal is stronger below half health.

stats.name: Immediate healing multiplier below half health

abilities.name: Immortality Field
abilities.description: Place a destroyable device that keeps nearby allies from dying.

abilities.name: Amplification Matrix
abilities.description: Place a window that amplifies friendly projectile damage and healing.

abilities.name: Exo Boots
abilities.description: Crouching prepares a higher jump.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Choose a position where your healing projectiles can reach the team without exposing you to every enemy sightline. Use Exo Boots to reach useful cover, rather than jumping constantly.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Place Immortality Field where allies can use it and enemies cannot immediately destroy it. Rotate healing and rifle pressure without letting an ally's emergency go unnoticed.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Amplification Matrix needs a usable firing lane. Communicate its position before the fight and do not force teammates to abandon cover just to shoot through it.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

perks.name: Expanded Field
perks.description: Immortality Field's radius is 30% bigger.

perks.name: Assault Burst
perks.description: Regenerative Burst now provides Baptiste with 20% increased attack speed for 3 seconds.

perks.name: Automated Healing
perks.description: Using any ability triggers Baptiste's Shoulder Turret, periodically firing up to 3 shots at allies, each restoring 40 health.

perks.name: Rocket Boots
perks.description: While airborne from Exo Boots, use SPACE to dash horizontally.

heroes.name: Bastion
heroes.biography: An omnic war machine that became an explorer with an interest in nature.
weaknesses: Artillery stops movement
Assault reduces mobility

attributes.Engagement range: Accurate Recon fire and Assault pressure
attributes.Skill floor: Start with covered positions and one reliable contribution.
attributes.Skill ceiling: Artillery commits your position. Start it from safety and place shots around the enemy's likely movement and escape choices; treat forcing a rotation as useful pressure.

abilities.name: Configuration: Assault
abilities.description: Trade movement speed for sustained rotary-cannon fire.

abilities.name: Configuration: Recon
abilities.description: Use the accurate mobile configuration when repositioning.

abilities.name: A-36 Tactical Grenade
abilities.description: The explosive ricochets from walls but detonates on enemies or the ground.

abilities.name: Reconfigure
abilities.description: Change between the two weapon configurations.

abilities.name: Configuration: Artillery
abilities.description: Stop moving to launch targeted artillery shells.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Use Recon to move between protected positions. Enter Assault when a target will remain in your line of fire, rather than when the whole enemy team can simply hide.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Keep a corner or teammate between you and a coordinated flank. Use the grenade to pressure cover, and leave a retreat route before your high-pressure configuration ends.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Artillery commits your position. Start it from safety and place shots around the enemy's likely movement and escape choices; treat forcing a rotation as useful pressure.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

perks.name: Smart Bomb
perks.description: A-36 Tactical Grenade's self-knockback is increased by 25% and no longer damages you.

perks.name: Configuration Reload
perks.description: Reduce the cooldown of A-36 Tactical Grenade by 4 seconds when changing configurations.

perks.name: Lindholm Explosives
perks.description: Configuration: Assault's weapon slowly fires explosive shells instead of a rotary cannon.

perks.name: Self-Repair
perks.description: Press E to rapidly heal yourself.

heroes.name: Brigitte
heroes.biography: An engineer who took up arms to defend others alongside Reinhardt.
weaknesses: Inspire needs damage contact
a frontal shield cannot cover every direction

attributes.Mobility: Shield Bash needs a raised barrier
attributes.Skill floor: Practice aim, resource timing and safe repositioning together.
attributes.Skill ceiling: Watch the enemy dive timing and answer it together with your other support. Rally is a team engagement resource; choose a fight your nearby allies can participate in.

abilities.name: Rocket Flail
abilities.description: Strike nearby opponents with a melee flail.

abilities.name: Repair Pack
abilities.description: Send a teammate a short healing effect.

abilities.name: Whip Shot
abilities.description: Extend the flail to push an opponent away.

abilities.name: Barrier Shield
abilities.description: Raise a barrier in front of you.

abilities.name: Shield Bash
abilities.description: With the shield raised, dash forward to push an opponent back.

abilities.name: Rally
abilities.description: Gain armor, strengthen the shield and grant nearby teammates extra health.

abilities.name: Inspire
abilities.description: Landing damage starts healing for nearby teammates.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Stay near allies who need protection. Use Whip Shot to discourage an approach instead of walking alone into enemy close-range damage.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Manage Repair Packs according to who is under immediate threat. Use your shield and movement to survive a duel while keeping Inspire opportunities safe.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Watch the enemy dive timing and answer it together with your other support. Rally is a team engagement resource; choose a fight your nearby allies can participate in.

perks.name: Combat Medic
perks.description: Melee attacks against enemies reduce the cooldown of Repair Pack by 0.75 seconds.

perks.name: Morale Boost
perks.description: Inspire lasts 3 seconds longer when activated by Whip Shot.

perks.name: Inspiring Strike
perks.description: Shield Bash grants 30% increased movement speed for 2 seconds. Inspire's healing is instant when activated by Shield Bash.

perks.name: Whiplash
perks.description: Whip Shot's knockback can slam enemies into walls, dealing 60 extra damage.

heroes.name: Cassidy
heroes.biography: An outlaw gunslinger who uses a revolver to carry out his own idea of justice.
weaknesses: Roll is a commitment
Deadeye cannot attach to Lifeline on this patch

attributes.Skill floor: Practice aim, resource timing and safe repositioning together.
attributes.Skill ceiling: Deadeye announces a threat and exposes your position. Check cover, interruption threats, and escape routes before activating it; forcing enemies away can matter even without an elimination.

abilities.name: Peacekeeper
abilities.description: Fire aimed revolver shots or rapidly expend the remaining ammunition.

abilities.name: Combat Roll
abilities.description: Roll to reload and reduce damage received during the movement.

abilities.name: Deadeye
abilities.description: Acquire targets before releasing the charged shots. Deadeye prevents attaching to Jetpack Cat’s Lifeline on this patch.

guides.body: Take a covered angle where Peacekeeper can threaten the enemy while you remain close enough for teammate help. Avoid chasing mobile targets into isolated routes.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Treat Combat Roll as a resource for survival and a timely reload. Aim to finish a realistic target rather than spending the whole fight shooting a protected tank.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Deadeye announces a threat and exposes your position. Check cover, interruption threats, and escape routes before activating it; forcing enemies away can matter even without an elimination.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

perks.name: Bang Bang
perks.description: Cassidy throws a second Flashbang that travels farther, but both Flashbangs deal 40% reduced damage.

perks.name: Giddy Up
perks.description: After using Combat Roll, Cassidy gains a 60% movement speed boost that decays over 1.5 seconds.

perks.name: Rollin' Round-Up
perks.description: Combat Roll also heals 15 health for each bullet reloaded.

perks.name: Silver Bullet
perks.description: Peacekeeper's secondary fire is replaced with a piercing shot that inflicts bleeding. Combat Roll and Deadeye reset its cooldown.

abilities.name: Surging Strike

abilities.name: Fusion Repeater

abilities.name: Eject!

perks.description: While holding Power Barrier, Propulsors fuel cost is reduced by 30%.

perks.name: Focused Fusion

abilities.name: Eject!
